title: Bagels and Lox
description: I just wanted to have bagels and lox in my Minecraft world, so I made this mod.
body:
# Bagels and Lox

I wanted to have bagels and lox in my minecraft world, so I made this mod to add them. Currently there are three types of bagels:

- Bagel
- Bagel with Schmear
- Bagel with Lox (includes Schmear)

If I get around to it, I'll probably make the crafting system more involved for all of the things, but as it stands right now everything can be made with vanilla recipe types.
